propositions: A plan that schedules recurring work using only a specific CI provider trigger (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and breaks silently for adopters with no CI provider or a different CI system.

The project.portability criterion's detection text must name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' as distinct, nameable shapes in the Platform and venue matrix to enable the reviewer to detect CI-only capabilities.

The criterion's rubric, its documentation mirror, test pinning, and agent guidance must all carry the same authoritative wording of the no-CI-provider rule to prevent drift and ensure consistent detection.
Live A/B testing must confirm the rubric detects a GitHub-Actions-only plan as a project.portability finding under the new rule and emits no finding under the pre-change rubric.
